name: comp-578
title: Mega Menu Navbar
description: A dark site header with a logo, four nav items, and Sign In plus a Get Started button; Features, Pricing and About each open a dropdown panel of links, some with descriptions or icons.
use: A marketing site needs a top bar whose sections reveal rich dropdown panels.
avoid: Submenus hide below the md breakpoint; mobile only gets a flat popover list without descriptions or icons.
a11y: The logo link has no accessible name, and the menu slide has no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-width dark header bar with a starburst logo at the left, then Home, Features, Pricing and About each with a small chevron, and Sign In plus a white Get Started pill at the right. A thin border runs along the bottom.
behaves: Opening a chevron item shows a rounded panel beneath it: Features lists three entries with descriptions, Pricing four products, About three icon rows. Moving to another trigger swaps the panel, and below the md breakpoint the menu folds into a hamburger popover.
customise: Menu labels, links, descriptions, icons and the right-side buttons are all written inside the file; colours follow theme tokens.
weight: light: A few links and one dropdown panel open at a time.
demo: Nav reads Home, Features, Pricing, About; panels name components, docs, templates and products A-D.
polishWhy: Three dropdown styles handled cleanly with even spacing; the logo has no wordmark.
